newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF expected to auction 20-yr JGBs on Tues-traders.
newsitem.headline: MOF expected to auction 20-yr JGBs on Tues-traders.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to hold an auction of 20-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) on Tuesday, bond traders said on Monday.
The MOF inquired about demand for 20-year JGBs on Monday morning, they said. The ministry usually holds an auction the day after it asks about demand for a certain bond in the bond market.

The new bond is likely to carry a coupon rate of 2.9 or 3.0 percent, traders said. When the MOF last auctioned 20-year JGBs on January 21, it offered 400 billion yen worth of 3.3 percent 20-year bonds.
